listing.name: WET (WET Recomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Windows package/launcher; source-build instructions also present Limits: Own disc import; launcher self-update explicitly replaces port files while preserving game folder. Non-owning route may be simplest. Upstream platforms: Windows10/11 x86-64 package/launcher and Linux x86-64 Vulkan source-build preset. WPF launcher is Windows-only; Linux requires extracted-data build route. Original data: Own WET Xbox 360 ISO. The upstream Windows launcher imports it into game/; Linux source builds use extracted data in game/. ReXGlue preparation consumes the game executable and assets. Reviewed README does not identify the accepted region, media ID, executable revision or digest. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
